tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open remote AI trainer jobs: paid work that trains and tests AI models, in coding, STEM, medicine, law, finance, languages, creative work, and more. Returns the newest jobs first, with pay, location, a short summary, and links. All filters are optional.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get one AI trainer job by its id (from search_jobs): pay, location, languages, level, hours, what the work is, the requirements, and the company's own description.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List the companies with open AI trainer jobs on aitrainerjobs.co, with open jobs, median and typical pay, worker rating, and how they pay. Use it to compare companies.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get one AI training company's profile: what it does, how and when it pays, how hiring works, what workers say (good and bad), and common questions such as "Is it legit?".
